name: Nicotinamide riboside
description: Form of vitamin B3 the body can turn into NAD+; made by chemical synthesis as a chloride salt

note.text: Injected NR has been described in people in one chart review of 8 people. Mouse results have not been reproduced in most human trials.

bullets: **Form of vitamin B3** that the body can turn into the coenzyme NAD+
**Raised NAD+** in blood and muscle in human trials
**Metabolism and aging** effects come mainly from mouse studies
**In people,** effects on health outcomes have been small, mixed or absent
Phase 3 in Parkinson's (410): worse than placebo
IV NR: one chart review of 8 people

practical.routes: By mouth (capsules); IV in one chart review
practical.pharmacokinetics: Blood NAD+ rose with each dose tested (8-week trial)
practical.monitored: Blood NAD+, safety blood tests, homocysteine

regulatory.text: No questions on GRAS notice for food use (2016)

references: JAMA, NOPARK trial of NR in early Parkinson's disease, Oct 2026
FDA, response letter to GRAS Notice GRN 000635, Aug 2016
